name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Run kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript on every pending video now. It’s the fastest way to turn raw video into searchable, reusable text—no manual work, no delays. The trade-off is temporary server load, but the payoff is immediate access to transcripts for editing, SEO, and repurposing.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s transcript tool risks flooding the pipeline with unvetted raw text—Luma’s built-in transcript tool already handles sync and speaker labels, which Reel’s manual mcp-server can’t guarantee. Instead, standardize on Luma’s native transcript output, then task the editor team to clean and timestamp critical segments within 24 hours; the artifact is a validated transcript log.
